﻿<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <UserSecretsId>aspnet-Bovis.Web-f58d0d52-c7b1-4ed4-ba69-edcbbb8f0754</UserSecretsId>
    <DockerDefaultTargetOS>Linux</DockerDefaultTargetOS>
    <PreserveCompilationContext>true</PreserveCompilationContext>
    <DockerfileContext>..\..</DockerfileContext>

  </PropertyGroup>

<!--
  <PropertyGroup>
    <AssemblyVersion>2.0.4.0</AssemblyVersion>
    <FileVersion>2.0.4.0</FileVersion>
    <Version>2.0.4.0</Version>    
  </PropertyGroup>
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <SonarQubeSetting Include="sonar.exclusions">
      <Value>wwwroot/**</Value>
    </SonarQubeSetting>
  </ItemGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <Content Remove="local.json" />
    <Content Remove="Views\RenderHtmlService.cshtml" />
    <Content Remove="Views\RenderHtmlServiceAltLayout.cshtml" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Update="assets/**/*">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
    <None Update="conf.d/**/*">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
    <Content Include="local.json"  Condition="Exists('local.json')">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </Content>
    <Content Include="appsettings.json.in">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </Content>
    <Content Include="local.json.in">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </Content>

    <None Include="Views\RenderHtmlService.cshtml">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>

    <None Include="Views\RenderHtmlServiceAltLayout.cshtml">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Markdig" Version="1.1.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate" Version="8.0.11" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore" Version="8.0.11" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore" Version="8.0.11" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.UI" Version="8.0.11" />
    <!--PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Data.SqlClient" Version="5.2.1" /-->
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer" Version="9.0.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools" Version="9.0.0">
      <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
      <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers; buildtransitive</IncludeAssets>
    </PackageReference>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.VisualStudio.Azure.Containers.Tools.Targets" Version="1.20.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design" Version="9.0.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="RazorLight" Version="2.3.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="Dapper" Version="2.1.35" />
    <PackageReference Include="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore" Version="10.1.5" />
    <PackageReference Include="System.CommandLine" Version="2.0.0-beta4.22272.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="System.CommandLine.NamingConventionBinder" Version="2.0.0-beta4.22272.1" />
    <PackageReference Include="UnicodeInformation" Version="2.7.1" />

  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>

    <ProjectReference Include="..\BohrIS\Bovis.Web.Bohris\Bovis.Web.Bohris.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\LBEG\Bovis.Web.LBEG\Bovis.Web.LBEG.csproj" />

    <ProjectReference Include="..\Bovis.Interfaces\Bovis.Interfaces.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Bovis.Logging\Bovis.Logging.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Bovis.Storage\Bovis.Storage.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\DbTools\DbDrivers\DbDrivers.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\DbTools\DbUrl\DbUrl.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <None Update="status.md">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </None>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Folder Include="wwwroot\help\" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Content Update="wwwroot\libraries\bovis\helper.js">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>Never</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </Content>
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>---
{
  "ConnectionStrings": {
    "DataConnection": "sqlite:bohris.db",
    "ConfigConnection": "sqlite:config.db"
   }
}

---
{
  "ConnectionStrings": {
    "DefaultConnection": "Server=(localdb)\\mssqllocaldb;Database=aspnet-Bovis.Web-f58d0d52-c7b1-4ed4-ba69-edcbbb8f0754;Trusted_Connection=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true"
  },
  "Logging": {
    "LogLevel": {
      "Default": "Debug",
      "Microsoft.AspNetCore": "Debug"
    }
  },
  "AllowedHosts": "*",
  "Kestrel": {
    "Endpoints": {
      "Http": {
        "Url": "http://localhost:18080"
      }
    }
  }
}
